summary.text: Leslie Goldman, a Democrat from Bellows Falls, has represented Windham-3 in the Vermont House of Representatives since 2021.
She sits on the House Committee on Health Care.

paragraphs.text: Goldman came to Bellows Falls in 1982 as a newly graduated Family Nurse Practitioner and, with her husband, started a primary care practice at the Rockingham Memorial Hospital, according to her House biography.

She worked in primary care in Bellows Falls until 2008, completed a master's of public health at Dartmouth Medical School that year, and then practiced at Dartmouth-Hitchcock Keene before retiring in 2018 after 37 years in medicine.
She served on the Bellows Falls Union High School Board for 12 years and on the Rockingham Selectboard for three years.
She was a founding member of The Compass School and is on the board of The Nature Museum in Grafton.
